children: Phillips 66 reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $50.54B, up 46.4% from $34.52B a year earlier, and net income of $5.62B, compared with $133M. Diluted EPS was $14.08, versus $0.32 in the prior-year quarter, as higher refining margins supported earnings.
¹ Reported as “Sales and other operating revenues”. ² Reported as “Net Income Attributable to Phillips 66”. ³ Reported as “Net Income Attributable to Phillips 66 Per Share of Common Stock (dollars)”.
Worldwide realized refining margins rose to $38.00 per barrel from $12.15, while refining utilization was 98% for the quarter.
Phillips 66 approved the proposed 1,300-mile Western Gateway refined-products pipeline, in which it owns a 49.9% interest.
The company acquired Lindsey Oil Refinery logistics assets to support Humber operations and U.K. fuel supply.
Renewable fuels segment results improved as regulatory-credit values increased; production averaged 47,000 barrels per day in the first nine months.
